_note: Who voices whom (ElevenLabs). Put each voice's ID in voice_id: run 'npm run voices -- --list' to see the voices in your ElevenLabs account and their IDs, or add voices from the Voice Library first. The description is what to look for, or to design a voice from. Speakers with no voice_id are skipped. model: eleven_multilingual_v2 is the dependable default; eleven_v3 acts more (it reads stage directions) if your plan has it. stability: lower is more emotional and less predictable.

kasim.description: Redguard farmer, about 40, a former soldier. Deep, rough, quiet; says little and means it. Think a tired, dangerous man, not a hero.

hakon.description: Nord bandit, 30s, loud and brash, a bully.

bilal.description: Redguard thug, heavy-set, low and gravelly, slow to anger and then vicious.

jorund.description: Big Nord marauder, very deep, booming, half-mad.

fenn.description: Young bandit, wiry and nervous, higher voice, swears a lot.

qadir.description: The bandit chief, Redguard, 50s, cold and contemptuous, used to being obeyed.
